query: How can one lodge a grievance against a Block Development Officer (BDO)?
reference_answer:
Complaint against Block Development Officer (BDO):
To file a complaint against a BDO, contact the District Collector's office or the local Tahsildar office. You can also submit a written complaint to the Revenue Divisional Officer (RDO) or the District Revenue Officer (DRO).
answer: One can lodge a grievance against a Block Development Officer (BDO) by visiting the office of the BDO, contacting them via phone or email, or writing a letter to their local district administration office. [Document 1]
